title: Pure Infinitrack
summary: Pure Infinitrack heavy-machinery Xyz climb and industrial excavation build, pairing massive EARTH Machines with Level modulation and attachment mechanics. The deck tributes Machines to deploy Level 5 extenders, merges Levels to assemble Ranks 5, 7, and 9, and converts three Xyz monsters into the towering, effect-immune Link-3 Infinitrack Fortress Megaclops.

summary.title: Starters
points: Infinitrack Harvester adds any Infinitrack monster from your Deck to your hand upon Normal or Special Summon, and targets another Machine to modulate both of their Levels to their combined total.
Infinitrack Anchor Drill Special Summons an EARTH Machine from your hand upon Normal or Special Summon, and combines its Level with another Machine for Xyz plays.
Heavy Forward searches any Infinitrack monster upon activation, changes a Machine Xyz monster's battle position, and attaches itself to a Machine Xyz as material.

Infinitrack Brutal Dozer tributes an EARTH Machine to Special Summon itself from hand, and pulls an Infinitrack monster (such as Trencher or Tunneller) from your Deck in Defense Position, locking your summons to EARTH Machines.

summary.title: Opening: Infinitrack Harvester + Brutal Dozer
steps: Normal Summon Infinitrack Harvester, activating its effect to search Infinitrack Brutal Dozer (or Heavy Forward if Dozer is in hand).
Activate Brutal Dozer in hand, tributing Harvester to Special Summon itself.
Brutal Dozer triggers on summon to Special Summon Infinitrack Trencher directly from your Deck.
Overlay Brutal Dozer and Trencher (both Level 5) to Xyz Summon Rank 5 Infinitrack River Stormer.
Detach 1 material from River Stormer to search Infinitrack Tunneller or Road Roller from your Deck.
Link River Stormer into Link-1 Infinitrack Goliath, then use River Stormer's GY effect to attach Goliath as material to grant effect-destruction immunity.

summary.title: Graveyard Recycling & Level 5 Extenders
points: Infinitrack Trencher banishes itself from the GY to revive a Level 5 or lower Infinitrack monster from your GY.
Infinitrack Tunneller banishes itself from the GY to shuffle 5 EARTH Machine monsters from your GY into the Deck and draw 2 cards.

Infinitrack Road Roller Special Summons itself from hand or GY whenever an EARTH Machine is tributed or banished face-up; an Xyz with Road Roller as material shifts all opponent monsters to Defense Position and reduces their DEF by 1000.
Infinitrack Crab Crane and Drag Shovel search Outrigger Extension and Spin Turn respectively by tributing an EARTH Machine.

summary.title: Bosses & Rank-Up
points: Infinitrack River Stormer (Rank 5) adds or sends an EARTH Machine to the GY, and attaches an opponent's monster it destroys in battle as material.
Infinitrack Earth Slicer (Rank 9) detaches materials to destroy cards on the field up to the number detached, and attaches destroyed monsters as material.

Outrigger Extension protects your Machine Xyz monsters from being targeted by opponent card effects, and once per turn Ranks Up an Infinitrack Xyz into one 2 Ranks higher (such as River Stormer into Mountain Smasher or Earth Slicer).

Infinitrack Fortress Megaclops (Link-3, made with 3 Xyz Monsters) is unaffected by non-Xyz monster effects, cannot be destroyed by battle except by Xyz Monsters, and targets an opponent's card to attach it to an Xyz revived from your GY.
Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Juggernaut Liebe and Drill Driver Vespenato provide overwhelming multi-attack OTK power.
